card.name: The digit 8 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 8 when it appears partway through a multi-digit number, such as a year, a DOI, a verse number or CD38. It is usually followed by more digits or a closing mark.

modes.label: Digit 8 in references
modes.description: The 8 sits inside a DOI, journal number or Bible verse.

modes.label: Digit 8 in years
modes.description: The 8 is the last digit of a year such as 1638 or 1938.

modes.label: CD38 in drug text
modes.description: The 8 ends the CD3 marker name on red blood cells.
